check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.
check.governance_note: The government's news service quotes the responsible assistant minister on finalising national AI policy and shaping governance and data-ethics frameworks.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Communications and Innovation
related_bodies.role: Its assistant minister said in August 2025 that the government is working on finalising a national AI policy.

related_bodies.name: Information and Data Protection Commission
related_bodies.role: It is a data regulator; it has no AI mandate. This was reported by Lawyers Hub, Africa AI Policy Lab.

record.notes: Primary sources are Botswana Government Daily News reports of statements by the Assistant Minister of Communications and Innovation. The secondary profile reports no adoption through September 2026. Searched in English.
